'''Ignacas Stasys Uždavinys''' (30 June 1935 – 2 August 2023) was a Lithuanian mathematician and politician. A member of the [[Lithuanian Christian Democratic Party]], he served in the [[Seimas]] from 1992 to 2000.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.lrs.lt/sip/portal.show?p_r=35403&p_k=1&p_t=285817|title=Ignacas Stasys UŽDAVINYS|work=Seimas|language=Lithuanian}}</ref>

Uždavinys died on 2 August 2023, at the age of 88.<ref>{{cite news |last= |first= |date=8 August 2023|title=Mirė buvęs Seimo narys, matematikas Ignacas Stasys Uždavinys|trans-title= |url=https://www.lrt.lt/naujienos/lietuvoje/2/2052689/mire-buves-seimo-narys-matematikas-ignacas-stasys-uzdavinys|language=Lithuanian|work=[[Lithuanian National Radio and Television]]|location= |access-date=24 August 2023}}</ref>
